title: Low Energy in Men
subtitle: Common causes, evidence-based evaluation, management, and safety related to low energy in men.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports major causes such as hormonal deficiency, sleep disorders, psychological factors, and nutritional issues. Emerging evidence highlights complex interactions and individualized responses. Some treatments lack high-quality randomized controlled trials but have clinical consensus.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
